c74object.name: evi_svfs_tpt
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_svfs_tpt.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_svfs_tpt.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_svfs_tpt.genexpr file also requires:
evi_smooth.genexpr
evi_svfs_filters.genexpr
About this File:
Using this require file you can access all TPT SVF filter types in evieve.

entry.name: tptSvfCoeff ( )
entry.description:
Coefficients calculator for all of the basic filter types available, @see: MSP [evi.filter~] or gen~ [evi_filter] for an example wrapper
In 1: type=input: filter, (int) filter index (type), see abstractions or source code for listing
In 2: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 3: type=input: gain, Gain (linear)
In 4: type=input: fullQ, Q
Return 1: g, g coefficient
Return 2: r, r coefficient
Return 3: h, h coefficient
Return 4: cL, low mixing gain
Return 5: cB, band mixing gain
Return 6: cH, high mixing gain

entry.name: eviFilterTpt ( )
entry.description:
All-in-one coefficients calculator and filter section for all available filter types for use in gen~/GenExpr
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
In 2: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 3: type=input: db, Gain in dB
In 4: type=input: Q, Q
In 5: type=input: filter, (int) filter index (type)
In 6: type=param (optional): smooth, default: 0, If > 0, ms smoothing time of required mixing gains
Return 1: Filter, Filtered audio output

entry.name: tptSvfCoeffMorphFull ( )
entry.description:
Morphing filter coefficients LP..BP..HP..NOTCH..LP @like Ableton 'Morph Filter'
In 1: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 2: type=input: gain, Gain (linear)
In 3: type=input: Q, Q
In 4: type=input: morph, Filter morphing 0..1 interpolates LP..BP..HP..NOTCH..LP
In 5: type=input: comp, Switch 0/1 ensures notch clarity at high Q (if 'comp' is on)
Return 1: g, g coefficient
Return 2: r, r coefficient
Return 3: h, h coefficient
Return 4: cL, low mixing gain
Return 5: cB, band mixing gain
Return 6: cH, high mixing gain
Return 7: cN, notch mixing gain, additional to normal filter!
